Donald Trump has pledged to make the US the "crypto capital of the world" - backtracking on his [previous claim that Bitcoin was a "scam"](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-57392734). In October 2025, Bitcoin hit an all-time high of around $126,000, buoyed by a continued wave of institutional investment and positive market sentiment.But it has been known to [plummet](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-61796155) in value just as quickly as it spikes. *   [Brit says he is not elusive Bitcoin creator named by New York Times](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgrl4l1y9yxo). It functions in a similar way to Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, but in 2022 [switched to a greener operating system requiring less computers and energy](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-62891715). *   [How big banks are becoming 'Bitcoin whales'](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-68434579). *   ['A mockery': Trump's meme-coin sparks anger in crypto world](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crlkjejpwr8o). But as with other cryptocurrencies, [XRP has received regulatory scrutiny and seen sudden, sharp declines in value](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-55415350).
